Detrazione per affitto abitazione princi: Deduction for rent on your main home: up to €991.60 for low incomes. The contract must be registered.
Detrazione per i figli fino a 21 anni. D: A deduction for children up to 21. Since 2022 partly replaced by the single child allowance. Check what your household is entitled to.
Il codice fiscale è il tuo identificativ: The tax code is your unique identifier for every tax and administrative procedure in Italy. You get it free of charge at the Agenzia delle Entrate by showing your passport. You need it for work, renting, banking and healthcare.
Il datore di lavoro emette la CU ogni an: Your employer issues the CU every year by March. It certifies the income you received and the tax withheld. You need it to file the 730. If you do not receive it, contact your employer or their accountant.
Il modello 730 è la dichiarazione dei re: The 730 form is the tax return for employees and pensioners. It is filed between April and September each year. You can file it through a CAF (free) or a patronato. It lets you claim back deductions and allowances.
Indicatore della Situazione Economica Eq: The Equivalent Economic Situation Indicator. It measures your household's income. Required to apply for: free nursery, income support, family bonuses, utility discounts and access to social services.
L'ente fiscale italiano. Gestisce: codic: The Italian tax authority. It handles tax codes, VAT numbers, returns, refunds and audits. You can access its services online with SPID or your electronic ID card. Book an appointment at a counter for complex matters.
Ogni mese il datore di lavoro trattiene: Every month your employer withholds income tax and INPS contributions. Check your payslip: gross pay, deductions, holidays and TFR. The TFR (severance pay) builds up each year and is paid at the end of the contract.
